name: themehybrid/hybrid-cache
description: Cache package for the Hybrid Core framework.

suggest.ext-apcu: Required to use the APC cache driver.
suggest.ext-filter: Required to use the DynamoDb cache driver.
suggest.ext-memcached: Required to use the memcached cache driver.
suggest.symfony/cache: Required to use PSR-6 cache bridge (^7.2).
suggest.themehybrid/hybrid-database: Required to use the database cache driver (^1.0).
suggest.themehybrid/hybrid-filesystem: Required to use the file cache driver (^1.0).
suggest.themehybrid/hybrid-redis: Required to use the redis cache driver (^1.0).
